title: InkScript — Handwriting Studio
description: A handwriting synthesizer — pick a pen, tune the wobble and slant, watch your words get written stroke by stroke, then export the take.
concept: InkScript turns typed text into synthetic handwriting. Four physically distinct pens (ballpoint, fountain, marker, chalk) each layer strokes differently — fountain pens ink-pool at word starts and lay a soft double-pass line, chalk speckles with grain, marker overlaps translucent offset copies for a felt-tip look. A seeded per-character jitter and a sine-wave baseline wobble keep every letter uniquely imperfect but stable across re-renders, and a write-on animation reveals the text glyph by glyph with a moving pen-tip indicator.
features: 4 distinct pen physics (ballpoint / fountain / marker / chalk) with independently tuned stroke layering
6 live parameters: size, slant, jitter, baseline wobble, letter spacing, write speed
4 paper textures (cream, lined notebook, graph paper, chalkboard) plus a live ink-color picker
Animated write-on playback with a moving pen-tip marker, replayable on demand
Export finished page as PNG, or export the full write-on animation as a WebM video via MediaRecorder + canvas.captureStream
Named notes saved to localStorage (save / load / delete), plus autosave of the last session
Shareable URL — the whole note (text + every slider) round-trips through a base64 URL hash
tech: Seeded PRNG (mulberry32) for stable per-glyph jitter

interaction.mouse: Type in the text box; drag sliders to tune pen, slant, jitter, wobble, spacing, speed; click a pen swatch to switch physics
interaction.click: Replay plays the write-on animation from scratch; Export PNG/WebM captures the result; Save Note stores the current text + settings
interaction.touch: Full touch support — textarea, sliders and pen buttons are all touch-friendly; canvas is view-only so no gestures are needed
interaction.keyboard: Standard text-input keyboard interaction in the textarea; Tab cycles through all controls
